title: Questions and Negative Habits
introduction: Ask about habits and say what people do not do.
definition: Ask about habits and say what people do not do.
rules: Use do with I, you, we and they; use does with he, she and it.
After do or does, use the base verb.

grammar.description: negative habit for he or she

examples.question: ___ Amir read comics?
steps: Amir is one person, so use does.

exercises.question: ___ Amir read comics?
exercises.solution: Amir is one person, so use does.

exercises.question: She does not ___ football. (play or plays)
exercises.solution: After does not, use the base verb.

exercises.question: Does he ___ a bike? (ride or rides)
exercises.solution: Does already carries the third-person form.

exercises.question: Do you draw? Yes, I ___.
exercises.solution: Repeat do in a positive short answer.

summary: Ask about habits and say what people do not do. Use do with I, you, we and they; use does with he, she and it.
